caseName: Michigan Bell Telephone Co. v. City of Detroit
caseNameFull: MICHIGAN BELL TELEPHONE CO. v. CITY OF DETROIT
attorneys: Thomas O. Long, James M. Smith and Donald E. Brown for appellant in No. 497. Harvey A. Fischer and Richard Ford for appellant in No. 498., John H. Witherspoon for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeals are dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
